rule: Each question asks for the same fact as the original but shares no content word (and, for words of 5+ letters, no 4-letter word start) with the fact's evidence sentence or answer value. Written by the engine author; not independently reviewed.

questions.merchant: Which retailer or seller took part?
questions.ticket: What case number was opened for this outage?
questions.service: Which component directed card purchases to processors?
questions.owner: Which group was responsible for fixing the problem?
questions.queue: Which channel transported the clearing notifications?
questions.rollback: Which version did they revert to?
questions.runbook: Which written procedure did the on-call staff follow?
questions.cluster: On which group of machines did the job run?
questions.bucket: Where were the compliance downloads kept in object storage?
questions.region: In which geographic location did the impacted rollout run?
questions.canary: Which early-warning probe spotted the performance drop?
questions.dashboard: Which monitoring screen showed response delay?
questions.certificate: Which TLS credential needed to be swapped out?
questions.trace: What correlation ID tied the broken calls together?
questions.replica: Which copy of the data returned outdated results?
questions.schema: Which data-model revision caused the incompatibility?
questions.retries: How many repeat attempts were set up?
questions.timeout: What wait limit was used before giving up?
questions.region_backup: Which location was kept on standby for disaster scenarios?
questions.namespace: Which isolation scope held the background jobs?
questions.endpoint: Where was the rerouted load sent?
questions.checksum: Which hash confirmed the restored backup was intact?
questions.shard: Which data segment was found to be at fault?
questions.batch: Which group of jobs was run again once things were restored?
questions.approval: Which sign-off permitted rebooting the system?
questions.handoff: Which transfer note wrapped up the inquiry?
questions.archive: Where was the last proof kept long-term?
